definitions.explanation: To engage someone for work or services.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{社員|しゃいん}を雇う。

notes:
{雇|やと}う is a godan verb meaning to hire or employ someone.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: 〜を{雇|やと}う

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {社員|しゃいん}を{雇|やと}う: to hire an employee
- アルバイトを{雇|やと}う: to hire a part-timer
- {人|ひと}を{雇|やと}う: to hire someone
- {正社員|せいしゃいん}として{雇|やと}う: to hire as a full-time employee

COMPOUNDS:
- {雇用|こよう}: employment
- {雇|やと}い{主|ぬし}: employer
- {雇|やと}い{入|い}れる: to take on, hire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {採用|さいよう}する: to hire (more formal, often for new graduates)
- {解雇|かいこ}する: to fire, dismiss (opposite)
